name: iron cross stretch
description: Lie on your back with your arms out and cross one leg over your body toward the opposite hand. It stretches the glutes and lower back.
instructions: Lie on your back with both arms extended to the sides.
Keep one leg long on the floor and raise the other leg toward the ceiling.
Guide the raised leg across your body toward the opposite hand while keeping both shoulders close to the floor.
Hold a comfortable stretch through the hip and lower back, then return slowly and switch legs.
